name: Myōkō (Japan, city)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Myōkō city emblem in green: a stylised mountain range of three peaks.
history: Municipal flag of Myōkō, a city in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 2005.

features.role: Myōkō city emblem — a stylised mountain range of three peaks
